jobs.occupation: Team Lead Applied AI Engineering / Forward-Deployed AI 2 Lead (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: Job Posting: Team Lead Applied AI Engineering / Forward-Deployed AI 2 LeadLocation: GlobalDepartment: DI AUT IT AIDA AI 2Job Grade: non senior management / ÜT fähigMode of Employment: Permanent / Full-time & Part-timeGRIP: IT-IT-INTEC-TL999 / IT Team LeaderExternal Posting?: NoHiring Manger: Belen BandieraThe official start of this Leadership role is planned for October 1st 2026. As part of our transformation towards ONE Tech Company it plays a key role in shaping the future of our organization.What we offer you- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions- Diverse health and wellness offerings- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of SiemensSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and devleopment opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.Transform the everyday.In this role, you will lead a team of Applied AI Engineers working closely with Siemens DI functions to identify, design, deliver, and operate impactful AI solutions. You will help stakeholders understand what is possible with AI, translate domain challenges into concrete impactful use cases, and guide solutions from early discovery through prototype, MVP, and production readiness.How you will make an Impact with us- Lead a team of Applied AI Engineers delivering impactful AI solutions for Siemens DI business functions.- Partner with domain/functions experts and business stakeholders to transform internal processes with AI.- Translate business pain points or business process into clear AI use cases, technical solution concepts, value KPIs, and delivery plans.- Guide AI solutions from consulting and PoV/prototype through MVP and production-ready operation.- Provide technical leadership on AI architecture, software engineering, evaluation, monitoring, and security.- Coach AI engineers in both technical excellence and stakeholder-facing consulting.- Build trust with senior stakeholders by explaining AI opportunities, limitations, risks, and value potential.- Ensure AI solutions are robust, secure, maintainable, compliant, and measurable.- Collaborate with DI IT, HUB, platform teams, cybersecurity, legal, worker-council stakeholders, product teams, and domain organizations.What you bring- 5+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, or software engineering.- 2+ years of experience leading AI engineers/ Data Scientist, or complex cross-functional technical software initiatives.- Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and delivering AI/ML solutions cloud first, including evaluation, guardrails, and observability.- Strong software engineering foundation, including Python, APIs, data pipelines, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and production operations in the cloud.- Ability to communicate effectively with both executives and AI engineers.- Strong business-value orientation and ability to define measurable business outcomes and drive the technical implantation to measure them after go live.- Experience in enterprise environments with security, compliance, data governance, and integration constraints.- High ownership, pragmatic judgment, and the ability to create clarity in ambiguous situations.- In this role, your focus will be on sales (configuration, pricing, quoting, sales ops & performance) related business functions and SHERPA related use cases.You are the right person if- You can walk into a domain conversation, understand the real process, and identify where AI could create value.- You are obsessed with creating real measurable impact with AI- You can inspire stakeholders with what is possible, helping them transform the way they work in their departments with AI, while staying grounded in feasibility, data, risk, and measurable impact.- You can guide your team in architecture and challenge engineering decisions.- You enjoy developing people and raising the engineering bar.- You want to build AI solutions that move beyond demos and become sustainable, production-ready capabilities.Languages: Fluent in English, additional languages are a plusYou are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!Please note, this position will be based in the Siemens location where the selected candidate currently is located. The role has been assessed as a level (TL999). The actual compensation range will vary based on work location, applicable salary structure, experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Candidates will receive compensation information relevant to their location during the recruitment process in accordance with local legal requirements and Siemens compensation practices. For further information regarding the compensation details that apply to you and your country, please contact the recruiter directly.At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preferenceAbout usSiemens Digital Industries Automation (DI AUT) is one of the world’s leading providers of industrial automation. Our innovative automation portfolio enables companies of all sizes in both the process and discrete manufacturing industries to accelerate their automation—and thus their digital transformation—across the entire value chain. This allows our customers to increase productivity and flexibility and become future-ready through technologies such as software-defined systems and artificial intelligence. Siemens Xcelerator—the open digital business platform—helps to implement this more easily, quickly, and at scale. Together with partners and a broad ecosystem, Siemens supports its customers on their journey toward becoming a Digital Enterprise. otc2026di

jobs.occupation: Associate, Recruiting in Munich or Dusseldorf (Recruiter/in)
jobs.description: WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work (https://www.bain.com/about/awards-recognition/) list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH Join a group of talent acquisition experts who are the top of their field for attracting and hiring the top of every other field. We manage the full candidate lifecycle and just as Bain is only as good as its people, its people are only as good as our process. If you’re interested in learning how a top management consulting firm creates an impressive candidate experience, this is the team for you.WHAT YOU’LL DO - As Associate, Recruiting (m/f/d), you will support our Intern Hire Team in attracting outstanding talent for consulting internships across our offices in Germany & Austria.- In this role, you will serve as the central point of contact for all candidates throughout the Talent Journey – from the initial contact at a university event through to candidate support during our assessment days.- You will also be responsible for the pre-selection of the most promising candidates for our selection process and will oversee the preparation, execution and follow-up of our assessment days.- You give free rein to your creativity in conceptualizing, planning and executing our campus activities and (flagship) recruiting events, and collaborate with your team colleagues to develop strategies and concepts to further advance our intern hiring.- With your communicative and approachable manner, you also support our internal consultants with all recruiting-related queries.- To make our recruiting success measurable, you regularly prepare analyses along the Talent Journey and present these to your key stakeholders.ABOUT YOU- You have a genuine passion for talent and recruiting.- You leverage your strong communication skills to attract talented individuals to Bain.- You have a strong service orientation and a genuine enthusiasm for daily interaction with candidates and Bainies.- You look forward to taking on responsibility and independently driving topics forward. - You are a resilient and assertive organisational talent who does not shy away from challenges and keeps a cool head under pressure.- You truly thrive in a team setting, built on a foundation of loyalty and reliability.- You are creative, have a sense of humor and impress with a warm and positive presence.YOUR EXPERIENCE- You hold a successfully completed university degree in business administration, social sciences or law, ideally with a focus on human resources management.- You bring initial experience in recruiting and/or campus marketing. - You are proficient in MS Office; initial knowledge of data analytics is an advantage.- Your German and English language skills are excellent, both spoken and writtenWHAT WE OFFER YOUIn addition to an attractive and performance-based remuneration comprising fixed and variable components, you will benefit from numerous additional perks:- Diverse training formats, language courses as well as buddy and mentoring programmes support your personal development- You benefit from the EGYM Wellpass and further offerings for fitness and mental wellbeing- Our mobility concept gives you the flexibility to choose between Mobility Cash, reimbursement of your public transport ticket or JobRad leasing- For us, flexibility means having the best of both worlds: the freedom to work from home and the opportunity to experience genuine team moments in the office – fully in line with our Work@Bain 2.x concept.- With our Community Impact Day and participation in Green Teams, you can make a meaningful difference for society and the environment- Affinity Groups such as Women@Bain promote exchange, networking and career development- Whether Team Retreat, Christmas Party or the „Bain-Wiesn“ – you will experience how fun and team spirit go hand in hand at Bain.- Whether free snacks, beverages or the subsidised catering in our cafeteria (in Munich) – you will find even more at Bain that makes your working day a little bit better.HOW YOU´LL JOIN USHave we sparked your curiosity about an exceptional career with us?
